what: On hover, all letters go out at 6px blur and transparent, then re-form from the first letter at .03s intervals over .35s power2.out — like the text being freshly typed. On release, the letters blur away from the first letter over .25s power2.in, and right after that they snap back from 3px blur in .3s

options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text to split (child, text with no tags inside). If absent, the element’s own text

from.where: shared.js .md-btn·.md-btn-dark — text of the blue button and the dark pill button
